input.quote: Garman agrees to indemnify Sparkling and hold it harmless from any and all losses, damages and expenses including without limitation, court costs, arbitration fees, penalties, fines, amounts paid in settlement of claims and reasonable legal fees and expenses of investigation (collectively the \"Losses\") which Sparkling or any of its respective officers or directors may incur due to a breach of this warranty.
input.rationale: Section 13 contains a Garman indemnity, but it is limited to breach of the IP ownership/non-infringement warranty and provides no express duty to defend, no coverage for Sparkling's affiliates, and nothing for Garman's breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sparkling data, or Garman's gross negligence or wilful misconduct (including resulting personal injury or property damage). There is no reciprocal Sparkling indemnity, and Section 15 already carves Section 13 out of the liability limitation, so the cap is not an issue. The inserted paragraph adds the missing indemnity heads and standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics, reaching the preferred position with a minimal addition to the existing section.

ops.text: In addition, Garman shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Sparkling and its affiliates from and against any third party claim, and all resulting Losses, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Work, or any Improvements or Modifications thereto, infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Garman's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Sparkling's data or Confidential Information caused by Garman; or (d) Garman's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, including any resulting personal injury, death or damage to tangible property. Sparkling shall give Garman prompt written notice of any such claim, Garman shall have control of its defence and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on Sparkling shall be made without Sparkling's prior written consent), and Sparkling shall provide reasonable cooperation at Garman's expense.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 gives us an infringement remedy tied to a warranty breach but no express duty to defend and nothing for Garman's own misconduct, so we have added a defence and indemnity obligation covering IP infringement, breach of law, data/confidentiality incidents and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. If needed, we can accept customary IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations or specifications) and a refund remedy as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Add Garman defence/indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard claim procedure.
